title.zh: Coinbase to Automatically Convert 14 Restricted Crypto Assets for EEA Users on O
title.en: Coinbase to Automatically Convert 14 Restricted Crypto Assets for EEA Users on O

current_state.zh: Coinbase will automatically convert 14 MiCA-restricted crypto assets, including USDT, PYUSD, DAI, and PAXG, for EEA retail users on October 30, warning that deposits after the deadline may not be credited or recoverable.
current_state.en: Coinbase will automatically convert 14 MiCA-restricted crypto assets, including USDT, PYUSD, DAI, and PAXG, for EEA retail users on October 30, warning that deposits after the deadline may not be credited or recoverable.
